reason: r6 approved for distribution. r6 does what clarkekoko's "Lock-on Target MHGU Recomp" and "No Target Reticle" cheats do with two Forge hooks that replace their function: the tap logic 0x27e970 for the local hunter (a tap toggles the lock; while on, only the single-tap target request, bit 0, is raised every frame, never bit 24; unlike the cheat it pauses while weapon R is held) and the reticle check 0x190d4, which returns 0 so the reticle is never drawn.
runtime_test: r6 accepted on MHGURecomp (updater 0.19.2) with Modern Weapon Controls r15: "now it works correctly, please promote". MHGURecomp logged "r6 loaded" and "holding the target lock"; the installed NRO matches the candidate. Eden, Ryujinx and Switch hardware not run for r6.
